params.name: lastRetailAuditID
params.description: Last retail audit ID already retrieved; start at 0.

items.docs: Returns up to 50 retail audits with an ID greater than lastRetailAuditID. Start with 0 and page using MetaCollectionResult.LastID until TotalCount is 0.

params.name: lastFormID
params.description: Last form ID already retrieved; start at 0.

items.docs: Returns up to 50 completed forms with an ID greater than lastFormID. Start with 0 and page using MetaCollectionResult.LastID until TotalCount is 0. A matrix variant returns matrix-style form answers.
